title: lepidium minor
intro: Lepidium minor, commonly known as cress or peppercress, is an annual herbaceous plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lepidium minor include its potential in treating conditions such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes, due to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. The health benefits of Lepidium minor are attributed to its ability to inhibit oxidative stress, enhance insulin sensitivity, and modulate the immune system.
